modules.description: Use standardized terminology, direct neutral prose, consistent labels, and evidence-bounded claims in all Chinese output.
Make GitHub Flavored Markdown the default for created or substantially revised Markdown files.
Require an exact impact and recovery review plus renewed user confirmation before destructive actions.
Review non-trivial requests by goal, assumptions, constraints, trade-offs, risks, and acceptance criteria.
Require confirmed consequential assumptions, bounded changes, contract-focused validation, and evidence-backed delivery.
Review Git identity privacy at installation and create independently verifiable commits with reviewed staged content and structured problem, implementation, boundary, and validation bodies.
Trigger the technical-documentation-writing Skill for substantial documentation work and enforce a compact baseline for terminology, evidence, procedures, safety, accessibility, and validation.
